prompt:
CAMERA: 35mm cinema lens, locked-off and completely static for the whole shot. The camera never moves, never pans, never pushes in, never pulls back, never shows itself.
LOOK: match the reference frame's grade EXACTLY: dim night interior, heavily desaturated near-monochrome, deep grey shadows, no daylight, no bright walls, real film grain. The ONLY colored element in the entire video is one tiny highlighter-yellow point at the fingertip.
STYLE: cinematic brand film, slow, held, precise. No glow, no neon, no lens flare, no light particles: every dot is a matte physical grain, like a halftone made of real grains.
CHARACTER: NO FACE anywhere, no head, no body, no person, no second person, nobody walks through frame. The only human presence is ONE right hand and forearm in a plain dark sweater sleeve, made of thousands of small matte grey grains gathered into the shape of a hand. Same hand and same dark sweater in every shot. The hand never walks away and never leaves toward the back of the room.
SETTING: a hospital nurses' station at night, completely empty of people. A wide counter in the foreground with a document tray and a monitor showing only abstract grey bars. The blank grid board on the far wall stays dark, out of focus and untouched for the whole shot.
CONSTRAINT: absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers, no signage, no handwriting, no typing of text. Keep text-bearing objects out of frame: no printed documents with visible type, no labels, no posters, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles. Any screen, paper or panel shows ONLY abstract grey bars, blocks, ticks and blank cells. Nothing is ever written or spelled. No colored element besides the single yellow point.
SCENES:
1. (~2s, wide, static) The empty station at night. From the LEFT edge thousands of small matte grey grains fly in along three thin converging pencil-like lines toward the counter. One tiny yellow point leads them.
2. (~2s, same wide static frame) The grains GATHER into the shape of a right hand and dark-sleeved forearm above the counter. The hand picks up one blank sheet of paper and slides it down into the document tray.
3. (~2s, same wide static frame) The hand presses the monitor once and an abstract bar chart on the screen fills up, empty grey slots becoming solid grey blocks one by one. Then the hand loosens back into grains and streams out of the right edge along the lines.
